nonGoals: use cheap models as final authority
force every task through every agent

useWhen: preprocessing expected to cost more than it saves
DIRECT_CROWN.invariant: direct Opus is the cost floor when chain overhead exceeds avoidable Opus work

LEAN_CROWN.crownPolicy: review semantic delta, never rewrite correct prose

CODE_CROWN.crownPolicy: review patch/diff and tests, not entire repo unless necessary

useWhen: ordinary Sol leaves a material hard residual

contextEconomics.reason: TypingMind warns changing Dynamic Context system prompts defeat prompt caching; use Dynamic Context on cheap preparation agents, then pass a compact evidence capsule to Crown.

omit: full source when targeted evidence spans suffice

sessionStickiness.mechanism: OpenRouter session_id if exposed through TypingMind custom body params

qualityRules: Cheap agents cannot lower the final quality floor.
Crown must independently reject material defects.
Direct Opus bypass is preferred when cheaper than orchestration.
Do not re-run identical work when a valid exact result can be reused.
Do not use Sol Pro unless an unresolved hard residual exists.
Do not give Dynamic Context to Crown when it destroys a valuable stable cache prefix.
For tool-heavy requests use quality-aware provider routing rather than floor-only routing unless tool reliability is independently established.

costControls.cheapModelProviderPolicy: floor for non-tool bounded preparation; default/Auto-Exacto for tool calls
costControls.builderPolicy: standard Sol; batch/flex only for asynchronous work outside interactive Flow
costControls.crownPolicy: stable prompt + prompt caching; minimize output; reuse Builder prose on ACCEPT
costControls.responseCachePolicy: only exact identical requests with freshness-safe semantics
costControls.hardSpendPolicy: fail or bypass rather than silently invoke expensive escalation

upgradeCeiling: No remaining generic upgrade is valid without new evidence, a new model/provider capability, a TypingMind feature change, or measured workload data showing a quality/cost regression.
